assessment: This important study is of significant interest to those studying neurodegeneration, demonstrating key pathologies in PLA2G6-associated disease in both patient-derived neuronal models and a novel trans heterozygote mouse model. It identifies a number of possible compounds that could potentially be re-purposed for therapeutic use in PLA2G6-associated neurodegeneration and provides a proof-of-principle in mouse that gene therapy with human PLA2G6 can rescue defects in PLA2G6 deficiency. The data are solid and convincing, and will stimulate future work to elucidate the precise molecular mechanisms at play.
